fieldValues.title: History too large to give, too hard to search
fieldValues.statement: A new document should be read against the group's earlier decisions and documents, but the history soon outgrows what a model can be given, and text search does not find the records that matter. Without the right history, the process cannot keep a document consistent with what came before.
source_ref: srs-programme source-documents/governance-minutes-2026-11-27/protocol-evolution.md, Tier 3.1: 173 decisions are 414 KB; lexical find puts the known related decision in the top five 52-56% of the time
